comparison.objective: Pack a lunch so yogurt and sandwich are adjacent to a flat ice pack.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained object packing and orientation, not threaded unlocking, collar rotation, or dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Ice pack flat; yogurt upright and sandwich flat, each within 5 mm of it; perishables placed away from it invalidate the score.
comparison.reason: Tests spatial packing under food-safety adjacency constraints.
